title: corydalis solida subsp. oligantha
intro: Corydalis solida subsp. oligantha, commonly known as Himalayan corydalis or corydalis, is a species of flowering plant in the poppy family. It is a perennial herb with a long history of use in traditional Chinese medicine, valued for its potential health benefits and therapeutic actions. The bioactive constituents of Himalayan corydalis include alkaloids such as yatabine and protopine, which have been shown to exhibit analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and sedative properties. The plant is also reported to have potential therapeutic actions including pain relief, anxiety reduction, and improved sleep quality.
